name: Somai Color Picker
description: A powerful zoomed eyedropper and color chooser tool that lets you pick colors from any webpage with precision.
storage_justification: Storage permission is required to save user's color history and favorite colors across browser sessions, ensuring a persistent and personalized experience. This includes saving recently picked colors, custom color palettes, and favorite color selections.
download_justification: Download permission is required to allow users to save color palettes, themes, and color codes in various formats like CSS, Tailwind configurations, and Android XML files for integration with their design systems.
